ns2:course.label: Community Recreation Planning
ns2:course.description: Studies the outdoor recreational use of lands in the public domain and their planning, concepts, and processes related to planning resource based systems; multiple-use in planning; planning criteria for outdoor recreation facilities. Prerequisite: Junior standing; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Junior standing; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: There will be a fee assessed for a Field trip in the amount of $30.
